snippet.title: FlatMMO Beta Released
snippet.description:
Play now! No login required!

Game: https://flatmmo.com

Welcome to FlatMMO — a browser-based MMORPG where every pixel counts.

Train your skills, fight monsters, and craft powerful gear, all in a living online world that runs right in your browser. No downloads. Just pure, old-school progression. Numbers go up!

Team up with other players for raids, trade items, or climb the leaderboards solo — the choice is yours.

Whether you’re chopping wood, forging weapons, or fighting desert bandits, everything you do shapes your journey.  Also it has plenty of afk activities if you have other irl stuff to tackle.

The game mechanics are very simple, but surprisingly deep as you progress.

FlatMMO — join the adventure, build your legacy, and rise from humble beginnings to become a legend in a 2D world that’s anything but flat.
